Announcement.description: A banner on all public pages, e.g. "Lightning: all matches paused until 14:00".
Announcement.title: Announcement

BlockAssignmentBody.description: All scheduled matches on a court that start in [start_time, end_time) get this referee.
BlockAssignmentBody.title: BlockAssignmentBody

CapacityCourts.description: `count` pitches; with `split_into`, each is a full pitch split into parts.
CapacityCourts.title: CapacityCourts

CategoryBody.description:
An age class (e.g. "G10" or "J12") within a tournament.

`results_public` defaults to `False` for children's classes (age 12 and younger) and `True`
otherwise, following the NFF rules.
CategoryBody.title: CategoryBody

CategoryKind.description: Who plays in the class: boys (G), girls (J) or mixed.
CategoryKind.title: CategoryKind

CourtSplitBody.description: Splits a full pitch into parts, e.g. an 11v11 pitch into two 7v7 halves "Bane 1A/1B".
CourtSplitBody.title: CourtSplitBody

CupSetupBody.description:
The whole cup. Courts are added to existing ones; the time windows replace the existing
ones (unless empty). Only possible while the tournament has no classes and no stages.
CupSetupBody.title: CupSetupBody

CupSetupNames.description: Names of the created stages and stage items, in the language of the organiser.
CupSetupNames.title: CupSetupNames

DrawBody.description:
`pots`: the teams to draw, pot by pot (best teams first). One pot is a plain random draw.
`seed`: the same seed gives the same draw.
DrawBody.title: DrawBody

EntryFeeBody.description: Sets the entry fee (NOK per team) of several classes at once.
EntryFeeBody.title: EntryFeeBody

FitGroupsPreview.description: What fitting the groups would create, for the confirmation.
FitGroupsPreview.title: FitGroupsPreview

GameFormat.description: NFF game formats ("spilleformer"); smaller formats are played on parts of a full pitch.
GameFormat.title: GameFormat

Official.title: Official

ParticipatingClubCreateBody.description: Creates a club with its teams at once: new teams, and/or existing teams without a club.
ParticipatingClubCreateBody.title: ParticipatingClubCreateBody

ParticipatingClubUpdateBody.description: Renames the club and sets exactly which teams belong to it.
ParticipatingClubUpdateBody.title: ParticipatingClubUpdateBody

PlanningHours.description: The opening hours of pitches and the days/hours of classes that have their own.
PlanningHours.title: PlanningHours

PlayingDay.description: A day of the cup in Norwegian time, with its playing hours, e.g. ["09:00-12:00"].
PlayingDay.title: PlayingDay

PlayoffBody.description:
One knockout bracket, e.g. "A playoff" for placings [1, 2] of every group. It can also take
the best teams at one placing across all groups: `best_of_placing=3, best_ranks=[1, 2]` adds
the two best third placed teams.
PlayoffBody.title: PlayoffBody

PlayoffPreset.description: No playoffs, one playoff for everyone, or A/B (/C) playoffs split by placing.
PlayoffPreset.title: PlayoffPreset

PlayoffsCreateBody.description: Creates a new stage after `group_stage_id` with a knockout bracket per playoff.
PlayoffsCreateBody.title: PlayoffsCreateBody

Podium.description: The placings of one playoff or group, e.g. "A-sluttspill" or "Pulje A".
Podium.title: Podium

PublicDelay.description: A delay reported from a pitch; the public only sees the court and the minutes.
PublicDelay.title: PublicDelay

PublicMatchOfficial.description: What the public, the pitch and printed cards may see: the name only.
PublicMatchOfficial.title: PublicMatchOfficial

PublicRegistrationBody.description:
A sign-up: one team (`category_id`, `team_name`), or several teams of one club in one go
(`teams`, possibly in different classes) with the same contact person.
PublicRegistrationBody.title: PublicRegistrationBody

PublicRegistrationClass.description: A class open for sign-up, as shown on the public form (no personal data).
PublicRegistrationClass.title: PublicRegistrationClass

PublicRegistrationResult.description: The first team (for one-team sign-ups) and all teams of the sign-up.
PublicRegistrationResult.title: PublicRegistrationResult

Registration.description: A team with its registration, for the organiser only: contains personal data.
Registration.title: Registration

RegistrationSettingsBody.description: Public sign-up for one class. Beyond `max_teams` teams, new teams go to the waitlist.
RegistrationSettingsBody.title: RegistrationSettingsBody

RegistrationStatus.description:
Teams created by the organiser are APPROVED. Teams that sign up themselves are REGISTERED,
or on the WAITLIST when their class is full. Both APPROVED and REGISTERED teams take part.
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

ReplanBody.description:
Changing the schedule during the cup. Played and started matches stay where they are.

- Without `keep_courts` ("a new schedule from now"): all other matches are planned again,
  not before `from_time`.
- With `keep_courts` (a delay): matches keep their pitch and order. The selected matches (all,
  one court or one class) start no earlier than `from_time + delay_minutes`; the others
  keep their time unless a delayed match pushes them (same pitch, rest, knockout order).
  Gaps such as the lunch break absorb the delay.
ReplanBody.title: ReplanBody

ScoreEntryMatch.description: A match as the score keeper sees it.
ScoreEntryMatch.title: ScoreEntryMatch

ScoreLinkValidityBody.description: Extends (or shortens) a link without changing it: the QR codes keep working.
ScoreLinkValidityBody.title: ScoreLinkValidityBody

StageItemInputBestOf.description:
The `best_rank`-th best team of all teams at `winner_position` in the groups of a stage,
e.g. the 2nd best third placed team. Determined when the next stage is activated.
StageItemInputBestOf.title: StageItemInputBestOf

StageItemLotsBody.description: Drawing of lots for teams that are equal on everything else (tiebreaker LOTS).
StageItemLotsBody.title: StageItemLotsBody

SuspendedPlayer.description: For the pitch page and printed cards: who may not play in this match.
SuspendedPlayer.title: SuspendedPlayer

TeamConflict.description: Two teams that must never play at the same time (they share coaches or players).
TeamConflict.title: TeamConflict

TeamConflictsBody.description: Exactly the teams that can't play at the same time as this team.
TeamConflictsBody.title: TeamConflictsBody

TeamPotsBody.description: Sets the seeding pots of some teams at once (e.g. from the draw page).
TeamPotsBody.title: TeamPotsBody

Tiebreaker.description: Criteria to order teams with the same number of points, applied in the configured order.
Tiebreaker.title: Tiebreaker

TimeWindowsBody.description:
The periods in which matches can be played, e.g. 09:00-12:00 and 12:45-17:00 on both days.
Replaces all existing time windows of the tournament.
TimeWindowsBody.title: TimeWindowsBody

allows you to do (the frontend uses this API as well).

Fore more information, see the [documentation](https://docs.bracketapp.nl).

post.description:
What-if for a cup that doesn't exist yet: do these classes fit on these courts within these
playing hours? Plans the resulting matches with the real scheduler and tells what's missing.

get.description: The matches of a score link (no account needed, the token is the key).

post.description: A yellow or red card (classes from 13 years with public results).

put.description: Kick-off at the pitch: the match keeps its place when the schedule is changed.
The other team didn't show up: `winner_team_id` wins by the tournament's walkover score.

post.description: E.g. "we're running 10 minutes late": shown to the organiser on the schedule page.

get.description: The announcement as set by the organiser, also when it has expired.

post.description:
A new round of groups composed by hand (e.g. by level, "nivådelt"), after the stages of the
class. Nothing is placed from results, so it's also possible when results are hidden.

put.description: The days and hours a class plays; empty: whenever the cup plays.

get.description:
Checks every age class against the NFF rules, e.g. at least 3 matches per team for the
13-year class and younger.

post.description: Make a tournament archived or non-archived.
A match host (kampvert) for a court during a period.

delete.description:
Undoes a split: removes all parts below the pitch. Matches planned on the parts are taken
off their pitch and time with `unschedule_matches=true` (otherwise 409); played or started
matches on the parts block it.

get.description: The matches planned on the parts of a split pitch (removed when the split is undone).

post.description:
Splits a pitch into 2-4 parts named after it ("Bane 1A", "Bane 1B", ...; parts of a part get
digits: "Bane 1A1"). A part can be split again. A match on a pitch blocks everything above
and below it, but not other parts of the same pitch.

put.description: The opening hours of one pitch; empty: the playing hours of the cup.

post.description: Creates `count` courts named "<name_prefix> 1", "<name_prefix> 2", etc.

Setup wizard: creates the classes, their group stages and playoffs, the courts and the
playing hours of a new cup at once. Teams are drawn into the groups afterwards.

get.description: Cards, the suspensions that follow from them, the settings and the jury's log.

Summary of the cup for the application to the district (krets): playing days, courts,
classes, teams and matches, plus the facts entered by the organiser. Organiser only.
Per class: the final placings, the prize ceremony time and the medals to hand out.
The final placings of all classes as a spreadsheet.

post.description: Logs a decision of the jury; with a card, it can add or remove suspended matches.

get.description: The cup's jury, with warnings for the NFF rules (at least 3, at most one per club).
Who refs which match, by name only (no contact details): also for public pages.

put.description: Sets the referee and assistants of a match (replacing the current ones).
Kick-off: a started match keeps its pitch and time when the schedule is changed.

post.description: The other team didn't show up: `winner_team_id` wins by the tournament's walkover score.

get.description: Get the rankings for the stage items in the next stage of the given age class (category).
Whether email is set up, the language, and the emails sent to team contacts.

post.description: Emails the current announcement to the contacts of all teams (once per text and team).

Emails each team its next matches, only to teams whose times changed since their last
notice. `dry_run` only counts them.

get.description: Officials with contact details, their matches and host blocks, conflicts and fees.

post.description: The official referees every match on the court that starts in the period.

delete.description: Also removes the official from their matches and host blocks.

get.description: The clubs taking part in the cup, with their teams.

post.description: Adds a club with its teams at once: new teams and/or existing teams without a club.

delete.description: Deletes the club; its teams stay, without a club.

put.description:
Renames the club, sets exactly which existing teams belong to it, creates new teams for it
and sets whether its teams may play at the same time.

get.description: The opening hours of pitches and the days/hours of classes that have their own.

parameters.description: Max number of results in a single page.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Max number of results in a single page.
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
schema.title: Offset

post.description:
Creates players from rows of a file (parsed by the frontend), at most 2000 at once, and
puts them on a team when given. Names that already exist (ignoring case and spaces) are
skipped, but such players are still put on the team.

Creates a new stage with knockout playoffs, e.g. an A and a B playoff, after a group stage.
Teams are seeded by their placing and teams from the same group meet as late as possible.

get.description: For the public pages: the current announcement and recent delays per court.

post.description:
Public sign-up of a team, or of several teams of a club at once (only for a public cup,
open classes and before the deadline). When a class is full, the team goes to its waitlist.

get.description: The classes that teams can sign up for now, with the spots left.
All teams with their registration, including contact details (organiser only).

post.description:
Plans all matches like `schedule/propose` and saves the result. Matches that don't fit are
left without a court and time.

get.description:
Problems in the current plan: overlapping matches, too little rest, matches outside the
time windows or on a court of the wrong format, knockout matches before their feeders.

post.description:
Plans all matches on courts and times within the time windows, without saving. Played
matches keep their place. Reports what's missing (courts or time) if not everything fits.
Like the preview, and saves the matches that change.

What a new schedule from a moment, or a delay, would change, without saving. Played and
started matches stay where they are; nothing is planned before `from_time`.

A link for entering results without an account, for one court or the whole tournament.
Owners and collaborators can create links: they run the match day. The token is in the
response only this once; the frontend link is `/score/<token>`.

put.description: Until a moment, or (empty) until the cup is over. The link itself stays the same.
Enters the drawn lots of the group (the LOTS tiebreaker), then updates the table.

post.description:
Group draw: places the teams of the pots in the empty slots of the groups of the stage.
One team per pot per group, and teams of the same club apart where possible. Returns the
placements in the order they were drawn, so the draw can be shown team by team.

get.description:
What changing the format of a class would create: its groups for the registered teams in
groups of about `group_size` teams, and its playoffs. Nothing is changed.

post.description:
Changes the format of a class. Before the draw its groups are made again for the registered
teams (about `group_size` per group); its playoffs are made again with the same placings or
from the `playoffs` preset. Planned times of what is made again are lost.

Moves a team to another place in the groups of the stage: an empty place, or the place of
another team, which then takes the old place of the first (a swap). Not for teams that have
played a match in the stage.

get.description: Pairs of teams that must never play at the same time.

put.description: Sets the seeding pots of the group draw for some teams at once. Empty means pot 1.

get.description: Returns the teams of the tournament, optionally only those of one age class (`category_id`).

parameters.name: limit

schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
schema.title: Offset

get.description: The matches of a team as a calendar feed (iCalendar), for calendar apps.

put.description: Sets the teams that can't play at the same time as this one (shared coach or players).

post.description: Undoes the withdrawal mark. Walkovers that were given stay; change them per match.

The team withdraws: its opponents get a walkover in all matches it hasn't played yet; the
schedule stays as it is. Returns the number of matches given as walkover.

put.description: Sets the periods in which matches can be played, replacing the existing ones.
